integrity: Analytical proof of all-dimensional exact formula and extremizer localization; integer/rational standalone checks are corroborative, not proof for unbounded dimension. Novelty subject to limitations of accessible historical missing-point design literature.
scientific_limitations: Uniform counting law on the Boolean cube with exactly one deleted vertex, degree-at-most-one real affine fit, and the canonical orthogonal projection only; no higher-degree or multi-deletion classification.
title: Corner-deletion instability and dual extremizers for affine least squares on Boolean cubes
